extracted.intended_audience: journalists/media, reporters, and the general public seeking company press information
extracted.subtask_description: Elements and practical expectations for a company newsroom / press release web page (contacts, headlines, dates, categories, assets, and navigation). Useful for producing or evaluating corporate press release pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press inquiries contact
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a clear, dedicated contact (email or phone) for media/press inquiries prominently on the newsroom page so journalists can reach PR staff directly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-media inquiries contact
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distinguish and provide a separate contact channel for customers or non-media inquiries (support) to avoid overloading press contacts and to route queries appropriately.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media assets / press kit availability
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offer downloadable media assets and a press kit (logos, high-res images, brand guidelines, fact sheets) so reporters have ready-to-use materials; make this prominent and easy to access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clear headline / title for each item
rubrics_metrics.description: Article titles shown, e.g. "Introducing Claude Opus 4.7", "Introducing Claude Design by Anthropic Labs", "Project Glasswing"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each press item should have a concise, descriptive headline that clearly communicates the announcement or topic; headlines should be linkable to the full release.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication date
rubrics_metrics.description: Dates shown next to items, e.g. "Apr 16, 2026", "Mar 18, 2026"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Display the publication date prominently on each listing and on the full release so readers and reporters know timeliness and can cite the date accurately.

rubrics_metrics.name: Category / tagging of release
rubrics_metrics.description: Category labels such as "Product", "Announcements", "News" appear with items
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tag or categorize each release (product, announcement, news, etc.) to help users and journalists find relevant items and to communicate the nature of the content at a glance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lead summary / short description
rubrics_metrics.description: Short descriptive lines under titles, e.g. "Our latest Opus model brings stronger performance across coding, agents, vision, and multi-step tasks..."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a brief one- to two-sentence lede or summary on the listing page to convey the core message and entice clicks; the lede should capture the who/what/why succinctly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search and filter controls
rubrics_metrics.description:
Search
Date
Category
Title (filters shown in header)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide search and filtering (by date, category, title, etc.) to let users quickly locate specific announcements or time ranges within the newsroom archive.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clickable links to full release pages
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles and items in the list link to the full article content (implied by listing style)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each listing should link to a full press release page with detailed copy, quotes, and downloadable assets so journalists can access complete information and embargo details if any.

rubrics_metrics.name: Archive navigation / pagination / 'See more'
rubrics_metrics.description: A 'See more' control and a chronological list of items (recent items visible with option to load more)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Support archive navigation and pagination (or infinite scroll) so users can browse older announcements; surface recent/high-priority items first and provide an obvious way to view additional items.
